generic.Defined scope/population: All agile delivery metrics reported on the PMO agile dashboard for squads in the train.
generic.In-scope period: The current framework version cycle, reviewed at each quarterly metric refresh.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each metric carries formula, Jira source field or JQL, reporting grain and refresh cadence.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of dashboard metric tiles equals count of published metric definitions in Confluence.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Confluence definition page holds version, author and publish date in page history.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Metrics without an agreed formula are listed as open with owner and target date.
generic.Test population: Every metric tile on the PMO agile dashboard.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: All dashboard metrics trace to a published definition with formula and Jira source.
generic.Exception handling path: Undefined metric is removed from the dashboard or defined before the next refresh.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Definition page published with formula, Jira source, grain and cadence for every metric.
generic.Evidence location: Confluence agile metrics definition page linked from the PMO agile dashboard.

steps.title: Draft the agile metric inventory page in Confluence
sop: Create the agile delivery metrics definition page in the PMO Confluence space.
List velocity, cycle time, lead time, sprint predictability and defect escape rate as sections.
Record the page owner and the review cadence in the page header.
Done when the definition page exists with one section per in-scope metric.
verify: Open the Confluence page and confirm a section exists for each of the five metrics.
Pass when every in-scope metric has a named section and a page owner.

steps.title: Write the calculation formula for each metric on the Confluence page
sop: State the numerator, denominator and rounding rule for each metric in plain terms.
Define velocity as completed story points per sprint and predictability as committed versus completed.
State the treatment of carry-over, spikes and unestimated items in each formula.
Done when every metric section carries an unambiguous formula.
verify: Re-read each formula and confirm two people would compute the same number from it.
Pass when no metric section is left without a stated formula.

steps.title: Map each metric to its Jira field or JQL source
sop: Identify the Jira field, board or JQL query that produces each metric input.
Run the JQL in Jira and paste the query string onto the definition page.
Note where Jira Align is the source instead of Jira for train-level metrics.
Done when every metric names a reproducible Jira or Jira Align source.
verify: Re-run one JQL per metric and compare the count to the figure on the page.
Pass when each metric resolves to a runnable query returning the stated population.

steps.title: Set the reporting grain and refresh cadence per metric
sop: State whether each metric reports per squad, per train or per sprint.
State the refresh cadence and the point in the sprint the figure becomes final.
Note any metric that cannot be produced at squad grain and explain why.
Done when grain and cadence are recorded against every metric.
verify: Check each metric section for both a grain and a cadence statement.
Pass when no metric is published without grain and refresh cadence.

steps.title: Agree the definitions with squad Scrum Masters and the Product Owner
sop: Circulate the draft definition page to the Scrum Masters of every squad in the train.
Run a working session to resolve differences in how squads count points and carry-over.
Record agreement or open dissent against each metric on the page.
Done when every squad has stated agreement or a logged objection.
verify: Check the agreement table lists every squad in the train.
Pass when no squad is absent from the agreement record.

steps.title: Publish the page and link it from the PMO agile dashboard
sop: Increment the page version and complete the change history entry.
Add the definition page link to each metric tile on the PMO agile dashboard.
Notify the PMO channel that the definitions are live.
Done when every dashboard tile links to its published definition.
verify: Click through each dashboard tile link and confirm it reaches the definition section.
Pass when no dashboard metric appears without a matching published definition.

generic.Defined scope/population: All Azure Boards work-item types, states and templates used by the delivery project.
generic.In-scope period: The configuration release window before the squad starts using the new process template.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Acceptance criteria, business value and target release are mandatory on transition to Active.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of configured work-item types matches the Epic to Bug hierarchy defined in the design.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Inherited process template version and change date recorded in Azure DevOps process history.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any type left on default states is listed with the reason and a remediation date.
generic.Test population: All work-item types enabled on the delivery project process template.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every type carries the agreed states and required fields with transitions restricted.
generic.Exception handling path: Types left on default states are remediated before the squad uses the board.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Custom process applied with Epic, Feature, Story, Task and Bug types configured.
generic.Evidence location: Azure DevOps inherited process configuration and its change history.

steps.title: Create the inherited process template in Azure DevOps
sop: Copy the system process to a new inherited process rather than editing the system process.
Name the process for the delivery project and record its purpose.
Confirm no change is made directly to the out-of-the-box process.
Done when the inherited process exists and is selectable for the project.
verify: Open Azure DevOps process settings and confirm the inherited process is listed.
Pass when the system process shows no modifications.

steps.title: Define the Epic to Bug work-item hierarchy in the process template
sop: Enable Epic, Feature, Story, Task and Bug types on the inherited process.
Set the parent and child rules so Story rolls to Feature and Feature rolls to Epic.
Disable types the squad will not use so the backlog stays clean.
Done when the five-level hierarchy is enabled with parent rules set.
verify: Create a test Story and confirm it can be parented to a Feature only.
Pass when no enabled type sits outside the agreed hierarchy.

steps.title: Configure workflow states and allowed transitions per type
sop: Add New, Ready, Active, In Test, Blocked and Done states to each work-item type.
Restrict transitions so an item cannot reach Done without passing In Test.
Map each custom state to the correct state category for board and reporting behaviour.
Done when every type carries the agreed states with restricted transitions.
verify: Attempt a New to Done transition on a test item in Azure DevOps.
Pass when the disallowed transition is rejected on every work-item type.

steps.title: Make acceptance criteria, business value and target release mandatory
sop: Add or expose the acceptance criteria, business value and target release fields on Story and Bug.
Set each field as required on transition to Active using a process rule.
Confirm the rule fires for both the board and the work-item form.
Done when the three fields block transition to Active when empty.
verify: Move a test Story to Active with the fields empty in Azure DevOps.
Pass when the transition is blocked with the missing field named.

steps.title: Publish the story and bug work-item templates
sop: Build the story and bug templates with the agreed default field values and prompts.
Share the templates at team level so all squad members can apply them.
Add the Given/When/Then prompt into the acceptance criteria field default.
Done when a new item created from the template opens pre-populated.
verify: Create one Story and one Bug from the templates in Azure DevOps.
Pass when both open with the expected default content in place.

steps.title: Apply the process to the delivery project and confirm with the squad
sop: Switch the delivery project onto the inherited process during the agreed window.
Check existing work items migrated to the new states without orphaning.
Walk the squad through the new states and required fields in a working session.
Done when the project runs on the new process with the squad briefed.
verify: Query for work items still on default out-of-the-box states.
Pass when the query returns zero items on default states.

generic.Defined scope/population: All shared delivery practices, ceremonies, tooling and definition of done between business PMO and IT Agile CoE.
generic.In-scope period: The current standing alignment cycle up to republication of the framework.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each divergence carries a description, the authoritative practice and a named owner.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of framework clauses compared equals the count in the CoE standard clause index.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Co-signed alignment note stored in Confluence with date and framework version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unresolved divergences are logged with owner, target date and interim working rule.
generic.Test population: Every clause of the PMO framework compared against the IT Agile CoE standard.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: All clauses compared and every divergence carries an authoritative source decision.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved divergence is logged with an interim working rule and a target date.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Alignment note co-signed by business PMO and IT Agile CoE.
generic.Evidence location: Confluence alignment note and divergence log linked from the framework page.

steps.title: Schedule the joint alignment session with the IT Agile CoE
sop: Book the session on the standing cadence with CoE and business PMO representatives.
Circulate the current framework draft and the CoE standard beforehand.
Confirm the Release Train Engineer and Product Owner attend for train-level decisions.
Done when the session is booked with both parties confirmed.
verify: Check the invitation acceptances in Microsoft 365 for both organisations.
Pass when at least one accountable representative from each side has accepted.

steps.title: Compare the PMO framework against the CoE standard clause by clause
sop: Build a comparison table in Confluence with one row per framework clause.
Record the CoE position and the business PMO position against each clause.
Mark each row aligned, divergent or not applicable.
Done when every clause has a recorded comparison outcome.
verify: Count the comparison rows against the CoE standard clause index.
Pass when no clause in either document is missing from the table.

steps.title: Agree which practice is authoritative for shared ceremonies and tooling
sop: Take each divergent row and decide which document governs for shared work.
Cover ceremonies, tooling configuration and the definition of done explicitly.
State the reasoning so later teams do not reopen the same argument.
Done when every divergent clause names an authoritative source.
verify: Review the divergent rows for an authority decision and reasoning.
Pass when no divergent clause is left without a named authority.

steps.title: Log open differences in the alignment log with owners
sop: Create a Jira item for each unresolved difference on the alignment log.
Assign a named owner from either PMO or CoE and set a target date.
Record the interim working rule teams should follow until it is resolved.
Done when every open difference is tracked with owner and date.
verify: Filter the Jira alignment log for items without an assignee or due date.
Pass when the filter returns no results.

steps.title: Obtain CoE and PMO signature on the alignment note
sop: Draft the alignment note summarising agreed positions and open differences.
Route it for signature to the CoE lead and the business PMO lead.
Capture both signatures against the note version, not a date alone.
Done when the note carries both signatures.
verify: Open the stored alignment note and check for two recorded signatures.
Pass when neither signature is missing before republication.

steps.title: Publish the alignment outcome to squads in Confluence
sop: Store the co-signed note in the shared Confluence space with the framework version.
Link the note from the framework page so consumers see the CoE position.
Notify Scrum Masters and the CoE distribution list of the outcome.
Done when the note is published and linked from the framework.
verify: Follow the framework page link and confirm it reaches the signed note.
Pass when the published note matches the signed version stored in SharePoint.

generic.Defined scope/population: All enterprise agile squads covered by the framework, including cadence, DoR, DoD and ceremonies.
generic.In-scope period: The drafting cycle for the current framework version prior to publication.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every ceremony records timebox, required attendees and purpose in the draft framework.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of documented ceremonies equals the mandatory ceremony list agreed with the train.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Draft framework held in Confluence with version number and change history entries.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Squads needing a cadence variation are listed with the rationale and approver.
generic.Test population: All framework sections covering cadence, DoR, DoD, ceremonies and escalation.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every ceremony documented with a timebox and required attendee list.
generic.Exception handling path: Squads needing a cadence variation are approved and recorded in the draft.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Draft framework complete with cadence, DoD and ceremony norms sections.
generic.Evidence location: Confluence framework draft with version history in the enterprise space.

steps.title: Set the standard sprint cadence and sprint boundary days in the framework draft
sop: Agree the sprint length and the sprint start and end days for all squads.
Align the cadence so squads finish in step for the train demo.
Record the cadence and any approved squad variation in the draft.
Done when the cadence section states length, start day and end day.
verify: Check the cadence section against the Jira sprint configuration for two squads.
Pass when the documented cadence matches the configured sprints.

steps.title: Write the enterprise Definition of Ready as an explicit checklist
sop: List the conditions a story must meet before it can enter a sprint.
Include acceptance criteria present, dependencies known and estimate agreed.
Phrase each condition as a checkable statement rather than an aspiration.
Done when the DoR is a numbered checklist of testable conditions.
verify: Apply the DoR to three real backlog stories in Jira.
Pass when each condition can be answered yes or no without interpretation.

steps.title: Write the enterprise Definition of Done as an explicit checklist
sop: List the conditions for Done including review, tests, evidence and acceptance.
Include the regulated-change conditions for evidence attachment.
Confirm no condition depends on a role outside the squad to complete.
Done when the DoD is a numbered checklist of testable conditions.
verify: Walk the DoD against a story completed last sprint in Jira.
Pass when every DoD condition can be evidenced for that story.

steps.title: Specify mandatory ceremonies with timebox and required attendees
sop: Document planning, stand-up, refinement, review and retrospective in the draft.
State the timebox, purpose and required attendee roles for each ceremony.
State the minimum attendance below which the ceremony is rescheduled.
Done when every ceremony carries timebox and required attendees.
verify: Read each ceremony entry for a timebox and an attendee list.
Pass when no ceremony is described without both.

steps.title: Define the estimation approach and velocity baselining rule
sop: State story points on the Fibonacci scale as the estimation approach.
Define the reference story convention so scales are comparable across squads.
Set the baselining rule for how many sprints a new squad runs before velocity is used.
Done when estimation and baselining rules are documented.
verify: Check the baselining rule gives a specific sprint count, not a judgement call.
Pass when the estimation section leaves no method open to squad choice.

steps.title: Document the impediment escalation path to RTE and PMO
sop: Map the path from squad impediment to Release Train Engineer to PMO.
State the response time expected at each level.
Name the forum where an unresolved impediment is tabled.
Done when the escalation path is documented end to end.
verify: Trace one live impediment through the documented path in Jira.
Pass when each escalation level has a named owner and response time.

generic.Defined scope/population: The squad Definition of Done and story acceptance standard applied to all squad stories.
generic.In-scope period: From publication until the next framework review of the squad working agreement.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every DoD condition names what must be true and where the evidence sits.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Jira DoD checklist items match the published DoD conditions one for one.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Published DoD page carries version, publish date and the squad walkthrough record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any story exempted from a DoD condition is logged with approver and reason.
generic.Test population: Every squad story subject to the Definition of Done and acceptance standard.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No story reaches Done with acceptance criteria empty in Jira or Azure DevOps.
generic.Exception handling path: Exempted stories carry a recorded approver and reason on the story.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Published DoD linked from the squad Jira board with the acceptance standard.
generic.Evidence location: Confluence squad DoD page and the Jira workflow configuration.

steps.title: List the core DoD conditions on the squad Confluence page
sop: Record code merged, peer reviewed and unit tests passing as conditions.
Add acceptance criteria demonstrated and no open severity 1 or 2 defects.
Phrase each condition so it can be answered yes or no.
Done when the core conditions are listed as a checklist.
verify: Apply the checklist to a story closed last sprint.
Pass when each condition is answerable without interpretation.

steps.title: Add the regulated-change conditions to the DoD
sop: Add the condition that test evidence is attached to the story.
Add the condition that business acceptance is recorded on the story.
State the acceptable evidence formats so testers do not improvise.
Done when the regulated-change conditions are in the published list.
verify: Check a recent regulated story for attached test evidence in Jira.
Pass when the DoD names both evidence attachment and business acceptance.

steps.title: Write the story acceptance standard requiring Given/When/Then
sop: State that every story carries acceptance criteria in Given/When/Then form.
Give one worked example from a real squad story.
State that criteria must be testable by someone outside the squad.
Done when the acceptance standard is written with a worked example.
verify: Sample five refined stories in Jira against the standard.
Pass when the standard is specific enough to reject a vague story.

steps.title: Configure the Jira Definition of Done checklist on the story workflow
sop: Add the DoD checklist to the story screen so it shows on transition to Done.
Configure the acceptance criteria field as required before Done.
Confirm the checklist items match the published DoD exactly.
Done when the checklist appears on every story transition to Done.
verify: Attempt to move a test story to Done with acceptance criteria empty.
Pass when the transition is blocked until criteria are populated.

steps.title: Mirror the DoD configuration on the Azure DevOps board
sop: Apply the same Done conditions to the Azure Boards story type where used.
Confirm the required fields match the Jira configuration.
Record which tool is authoritative for the squad.
Done when both tools enforce the same Done conditions.
verify: Compare the Done rules configured in Jira and Azure DevOps.
Pass when no condition is enforced in one tool and absent in the other.

steps.title: Publish the DoD and walk the squad through it
sop: Publish the DoD on the squad Confluence space and link it from the Jira board.
Run a working session covering each condition and how it is evidenced.
Record attendance and follow up anyone who missed the session.
Done when the DoD is published, linked and walked through.
verify: Open the squad Jira board and follow the DoD link.
Pass when the linked page is the current published version.

generic.Defined scope/population: All maturity dimensions assessed across squads: backlog health, ceremony discipline, flow, quality and engagement.
generic.In-scope period: The assessment cycle defined by the agreed assessment frequency.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each dimension carries five behavioural descriptors and a named evidence source.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Descriptor count equals five per dimension across every dimension in the criteria set.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Criteria document versioned in Confluence with the pilot findings recorded.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Dimensions the pilot found ambiguous are logged with the wording change applied.
generic.Test population: All maturity dimensions in the assessment criteria set.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every dimension carries five behavioural descriptors and a named evidence source.
generic.Exception handling path: Ambiguous descriptors found in the pilot are reworded before publication.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Criteria document published with 1-5 descriptors for every dimension.
generic.Evidence location: Confluence agile maturity criteria page with the pilot findings recorded.

steps.title: Define the maturity dimensions in the criteria document
sop: List backlog health, ceremony discipline, flow predictability, quality and business engagement.
State what each dimension is measuring in one sentence.
Confirm the dimensions do not overlap so a behaviour is scored once.
Done when the five dimensions are defined without overlap.
verify: Read the definitions and check no behaviour fits two dimensions.
Pass when each dimension has a distinct stated purpose.

steps.title: Write 1-5 behavioural descriptors for each dimension
sop: Describe the observable behaviour at each of the five levels per dimension.
Avoid words like good or mature and describe what a squad actually does.
Make the step from one level to the next a single observable change.
Done when every dimension has five behavioural descriptors.
verify: Ask a second Scrum Master to score a squad using the descriptors alone.
Pass when independent scorers land within one level of each other.

steps.title: Name the evidence required at each maturity level
sop: State the evidence source per dimension such as board view or velocity chart.
Include retro action closure rate as the evidence for improvement behaviour.
Confirm each evidence source can be pulled from Jira or Jira Align.
Done when every dimension names a retrievable evidence source.
verify: Pull one evidence item per dimension from Jira for a live squad.
Pass when no dimension can be scored without a stated evidence source.

steps.title: Set the assessment frequency and assessor rule
sop: Set the assessment frequency and the point in the quarter it runs.
State that a peer Scrum Master assesses, never the squad itself.
Name who resolves a disputed score.
Done when frequency and assessor rules are documented.
verify: Check the criteria document forbids self-assessment explicitly.
Pass when the assessor rule names a peer and a dispute route.

steps.title: Pilot the criteria against one squad
sop: Score one squad against every dimension using only the descriptors.
Record where the assessor had to interpret rather than observe.
Collect the squad reaction to the scores and the wording.
Done when the pilot score sheet and observations are recorded.
verify: Review the pilot notes for dimensions flagged ambiguous.
Pass when every ambiguity found is written down for correction.

steps.title: Amend the wording and publish the criteria to Confluence
sop: Rewrite the descriptors the pilot found ambiguous.
Version the document and record what changed and why.
Publish to Confluence and notify the Scrum Master community.
Done when the amended criteria are published and versioned.
verify: Compare the published version against the pilot findings list.
Pass when every pilot ambiguity has a corresponding wording change.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every in-scope squad in the train assessed against the agile maturity dimensions.
generic.In-scope period: The quarter being evaluated, using sprints closed within that quarter.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each squad score carries evidence links, the assessor name and the feedback date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of squads scored equals the squad list held in the train roster.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Quarter scores stored in the maturity tracker with assessment date and assessor.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Squads not assessed in the quarter are logged with the reason and reschedule date.
generic.Test population: Every in-scope squad in the train for the evaluated quarter.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: All squads scored on all dimensions with evidence links attached.
generic.Exception handling path: Below-threshold dimension triggers a logged Jira improvement action.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Quarterly evaluation recorded for every in-scope squad with feedback held.
generic.Evidence location: Maturity tracker in Confluence with the Jira quarter extract attached.

steps.title: Extract quarter velocity, predictability and carry-over from Jira
sop: Pull velocity, sprint predictability and carry-over for every squad for the quarter.
Use the published metric definitions so figures are comparable.
Store the extract with the run date against the assessment record.
Done when the extract covers every squad for the full quarter.
verify: Reconcile the squad count in the extract against the train roster.
Pass when no squad in the roster is missing from the extract.

steps.title: Score each squad against every maturity dimension
sop: Apply the behavioural descriptors to each squad using the extracted data.
Score every dimension, including the ones where evidence was hard to find.
Note the observation that drove each score.
Done when every squad has a score on every dimension.
verify: Filter the score sheet for blank dimension cells.
Pass when the filter returns no blanks.

steps.title: Attach supporting evidence to each dimension score
sop: Link the board view, velocity chart or retro closure figure behind each score.
Store the links against the score in the maturity tracker.
Replace any score based on impression with an evidenced score.
Done when every dimension score carries an evidence link.
verify: Open two evidence links per squad and confirm they support the score.
Pass when no score is recorded without retrievable evidence.

steps.title: Hold the feedback conversation before finalising scores
sop: Walk the draft scores with the squad Scrum Master and Product Owner.
Take corrections where the evidence was misread and record them.
Confirm the squad understands what would move each score up.
Done when every squad has had the feedback conversation.
verify: Check the feedback date recorded against each squad.
Pass when no score is finalised before its feedback conversation.

steps.title: Raise improvement actions for scores below threshold
sop: Identify every dimension scoring below the agreed threshold.
Raise a Jira improvement item with a named owner and target sprint.
Link the improvement item to the score that triggered it.
Done when every below-threshold score has a logged action.
verify: Cross-check below-threshold scores against raised Jira improvement items.
Pass when no below-threshold squad lacks a logged improvement action.

steps.title: Record the quarter score in the maturity tracker
sop: Enter the final scores into the maturity tracker in Confluence.
Confirm the trend line now shows the new quarter alongside prior quarters.
Publish the tracker update to the train.
Done when the quarter appears in every squad trend line.
verify: Open the tracker and confirm the new quarter is present for all squads.
Pass when the evaluation is recorded for every in-scope squad.

generic.Defined scope/population: All squads, business product owners and dependent IT teams in the programme increment.
generic.In-scope period: The programme increment covered by the PI Planning event through Inspect and Adapt.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each squad records committed PI objectives with business value scores in Jira Align.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of squads with committed objectives equals the squad count invited to PI Planning.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: PI objectives, ROAM board and Inspect and Adapt output stored in Jira Align by PI reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Uncommitted objectives are recorded as stretch with the reason and owning squad.
generic.Test population: All squads and dependent teams in the programme increment.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every squad holds committed PI objectives with agreed business value scores.
generic.Exception handling path: Uncommitted objectives are recorded as stretch with the reason and owning squad.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: PI Planning, System Demo and Inspect and Adapt held with objectives recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Jira Align PI board, ROAM board and improvement backlog for the increment.

steps.title: Book the PI Planning event with all squads and dependent teams
sop: Invite every squad, business product owner and dependent IT team to the event.
Confirm the facilities, breakout structure and the two-day agenda.
Chase acceptance from any dependent team not yet confirmed.
Done when every squad and dependency has a confirmed attendee.
verify: Compare the acceptance list against the train squad and dependency roster.
Pass when no squad or dependent team is unrepresented.

steps.title: Publish draft PI objectives and the feature list in Jira Align
sop: Load the candidate features into Jira Align ranked for the increment.
Publish the draft PI objectives so squads can prepare before the event.
Confirm each feature carries a business outcome statement.
Done when the draft objectives and features are visible to all squads.
verify: Open the Jira Align PI board as a squad member and confirm visibility.
Pass when every candidate feature is visible before the event opens.

steps.title: Run the draft plan review and capture risks on the ROAM board
sop: Run the draft plan review with each squad presenting its draft plan.
Capture every raised risk on the ROAM board with an owner.
Resolve, own, accept or mitigate each risk during the management review.
Done when every raised risk carries a ROAM disposition.
verify: Filter the ROAM board for risks without a disposition.
Pass when the filter returns no undispositioned risks.

steps.title: Confirm committed PI objectives and business value scores per squad
sop: Agree the business value score for each objective with the squad.
Separate committed objectives from stretch objectives explicitly.
Record the committed set against each squad in Jira Align.
Done when every squad has committed objectives with value scores.
verify: Query Jira Align for squads without committed objectives.
Pass when no squad enters the PI without committed and scored objectives.

steps.title: Run the System Demo against the increment content
sop: Schedule the System Demo on the train cadence during the increment.
Demonstrate integrated working software rather than squad-level slides.
Record stakeholder feedback against the demonstrated features in Jira.
Done when the System Demo has run with feedback recorded.
verify: Check the demo record lists the features demonstrated and the feedback raised.
Pass when no demonstrated feature is missing its feedback record.

steps.title: Run Inspect and Adapt and log improvement items in Jira Align
sop: Run the quantitative review, problem-solving workshop and retrospective.
Identify root causes for the largest impediments rather than symptoms.
Raise each agreed improvement as a Jira Align item with an owner.
Done when Inspect and Adapt has run with improvement items logged.
verify: Filter the Jira Align improvement backlog for the PI reference.
Pass when every agreed improvement appears with an owner and target PI.

generic.Defined scope/population: All agile templates held in the library: backlog formats, story templates, review agendas and retro guides.
generic.In-scope period: The current review cycle up to each template's stated next review date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every template carries version, owner and next review date on its page.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Template count in the Confluence space matches the published template index.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Confluence page history records each review with reviewer and date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Templates past review date are listed with owner and remediation date.
generic.Test population: All templates held in the agile template library space.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every template carries version, owner and a review date not yet passed.
generic.Exception handling path: Template past its review date is reviewed or retired before the next cycle.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Library holds current backlog, sprint review and retrospective templates with owners.
generic.Evidence location: Confluence agile template library space and its page histories.

steps.title: Consolidate all agile templates into one Confluence space
sop: Gather the backlog format, story template, review agenda and retrospective guide.
Move each into the single agile template Confluence space.
Remove copies held on personal drives and team channels.
Done when every template lives in the one space.
verify: Search Confluence and SharePoint for duplicate template copies.
Pass when no live template exists outside the library space.

steps.title: Stamp each template with version, owner and next review date
sop: Add a header block to every template page with version, owner and review date.
Set the review date on the agreed cadence from the last review.
Name an individual owner rather than a team.
Done when every template page carries the three header fields.
verify: Scan the template index for pages missing an owner or review date.
Pass when no template is published without version, owner and review date.

steps.title: Convert story and bug templates into Jira issue templates
sop: Build the story and bug templates as Jira issue templates on the squad projects.
Set the default acceptance criteria prompt in the Given/When/Then form.
Share the templates at project level so all squads use the same version.
Done when a new Jira story opens pre-populated from the template.
verify: Create one story and one bug from the Jira templates.
Pass when both open with the expected default content.

steps.title: Retire superseded templates and redirect their links
sop: Identify superseded template pages from the index and page history.
Archive each superseded page and add a redirect to the current version.
Check inbound links from squad spaces still resolve.
Done when no superseded template is reachable as a live page.
verify: Follow the links from two squad spaces to the template library.
Pass when every link resolves to the current template version.

steps.title: Run the scheduled library review on the published cadence
sop: Review each template against current practice on the published cadence.
Update content where the framework or tooling has moved on.
Record the review outcome in the page history comment.
Done when every template has a review recorded this cycle.
verify: List templates whose review date has passed without a history entry.
Pass when no template in the library is past its stated review date.

steps.title: Publish the template index and notify the squads
sop: Update the template index page with current versions and owners.
Link the index from the PMO landing page in SharePoint.
Notify Scrum Masters and Product Owners of the refreshed library.
Done when the index is published and the notice issued.
verify: Open the index and check every listed template resolves.
Pass when the index matches the templates actually held in the space.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every new squad member joining a delivery squad in the onboarding window.
generic.In-scope period: From joining date until the member is assigned their first sprint work.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Onboarding checklist records tool access, buddy, ceremony shadowing and DoD walkthrough.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of completed checklists equals the count of joiners on the squad roster.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Completed checklist and onboarding date recorded against the squad roster.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Members starting before access is granted are logged with the interim arrangement.
generic.Test population: Every new squad member joining in the onboarding window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: All joiners hold a completed checklist with tool access confirmed before sprint work.
generic.Exception handling path: Member starting before access is granted is logged with the interim arrangement.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Completed onboarding checklist per joiner with DoD walkthrough recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Squad roster and the onboarding checklists held in Confluence.

steps.title: Raise tool access requests for Jira, Confluence and the repository
sop: Raise access requests for Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps and the source repository.
Request the role profile that matches the member's squad role.
Track the requests to completion rather than assuming approval.
Done when every requested access is granted and confirmed.
verify: Have the new member log in to each tool and open the squad board.
Pass when the member can reach every tool needed for their role.

steps.title: Walk the new member through the squad board and workflow states
sop: Open the squad Jira board with the member and explain each column.
Explain the workflow states and what moving an item between them means.
Show where the sprint goal and burn-down live.
Done when the member can locate and update their own items.
verify: Ask the member to move a sample item across the board.
Pass when the member completes the transition without help.

steps.title: Walk the member through the Definition of Done
sop: Open the published DoD and walk each condition with the member.
Explain what evidence is expected for regulated changes.
Answer questions and note anything the DoD does not make clear.
Done when the DoD walkthrough is complete and recorded.
verify: Ask the member to state the DoD conditions for a sample story.
Pass when the member names the conditions without prompting.

steps.title: Assign a buddy and schedule ceremony shadowing
sop: Assign an experienced squad member as buddy for the first two sprints.
Book the first two ceremonies as shadow attendance for the joiner.
Tell the buddy what support is expected of them.
Done when the buddy is assigned and the shadow sessions are booked.
verify: Check the calendar invitations and the recorded buddy assignment.
Pass when both the buddy and the shadow sessions are confirmed.

steps.title: Confirm the member has read the framework and working agreement
sop: Send the agile framework and the squad working agreement links.
Ask the member to confirm they have read both.
Record the confirmation on the onboarding checklist.
Done when the member has confirmed reading both documents.
verify: Check the checklist for the recorded reading confirmation.
Pass when no onboarding is closed without the confirmation.

steps.title: Close the checklist and record the date on the squad roster
sop: Complete every checklist item and mark the onboarding closed.
Record the onboarding completion date against the member on the roster.
Only then assign the member sprint work in Jira.
Done when the checklist is closed and the roster updated.
verify: Cross-check joiners with assigned sprint work against closed checklists.
Pass when no member holds sprint work before onboarding is closed.

generic.Defined scope/population: Business-side product owners and delivery squads receiving PMO coaching support.
generic.In-scope period: The sprint in which coaching is delivered plus the follow-up sprint.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Coaching log records date, focus, observations, agreed actions and follow-up date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of coaching log entries equals the count of sessions delivered in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Coaching log held in Confluence with session dates and observation notes.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Coaching sessions declined or deferred are logged with the reason and new date.
generic.Test population: All product owners and squads receiving PMO coaching in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every session records focus, observations, agreed actions and a follow-up outcome.
generic.Exception handling path: Declined or deferred coaching is logged with the reason and the new date.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Coaching log records date, focus and agreed actions for each supported party.
generic.Evidence location: Confluence coaching log with the linked Jira items raised from sessions.

steps.title: Agree the coaching focus with the Product Owner
sop: Discuss where the Product Owner or squad feels least effective.
Choose one focus from backlog ordering, story slicing or stakeholder management.
Record the agreed focus in the coaching log before observing.
Done when a single coaching focus is agreed and logged.
verify: Check the coaching log entry names one specific focus.
Pass when the focus is specific enough to observe against.

steps.title: Observe a live ceremony and record behavioural observations
sop: Attend one live ceremony relevant to the agreed focus without intervening.
Record what was said and done rather than a judgement.
Note the moments where the agreed focus showed up.
Done when specific observations are written into the coaching log.
verify: Read the observations for statements of behaviour rather than opinion.
Pass when every observation cites something that actually happened.

steps.title: Run the coaching conversation and agree concrete changes
sop: Share the observations with the coachee and check they recognise them.
Agree two or three concrete changes to try in the next sprint.
Keep the changes small enough to be visible within one sprint.
Done when the agreed changes are written down with the coachee.
verify: Check each agreed change describes an action, not an intention.
Pass when every change can be observed in the next sprint.

steps.title: Provide the supporting technique guide from the template library
sop: Select the story slicing patterns or WSJF worked example matching the focus.
Send the guide from the Confluence template library rather than a private copy.
Point to the specific section that addresses the agreed change.
Done when the coachee holds the relevant technique guide.
verify: Confirm the link sent resolves to the current library version.
Pass when the material supplied is the published template, not a copy.

steps.title: Log the session in the coaching log
sop: Record the session date, focus, agreed actions and the follow-up date.
Link any Jira items raised from the session.
Store the entry in the Confluence coaching log.
Done when the log entry is complete for the session.
verify: Filter the coaching log for entries missing agreed actions.
Pass when no session is logged without focus and agreed actions.

steps.title: Check in the following sprint on whether changes were applied
sop: Observe or ask whether each agreed change was applied in the next sprint.
Record the outcome against the original log entry.
Agree a further step or close the coaching thread.
Done when every agreed action has a recorded follow-up outcome.
verify: Filter the coaching log for actions without a follow-up outcome.
Pass when no coaching action is left without a next-sprint check.

generic.Defined scope/population: The approved enterprise agile delivery framework and standards published to all delivery squads.
generic.In-scope period: From approval of the final draft to withdrawal of the superseded version.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Published page carries version number, approver, publish date and change history entries.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Change history entries match the tracked changes accepted since the previous version.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approval record and versioned page stored in Confluence with the publication notice.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Sections published with open review comments are listed with owner and closure date.
generic.Test population: The published enterprise agile delivery framework and its superseded version.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Published version carries an approval record and an incremented version number.
generic.Exception handling path: Sections published with open review comments carry an owner and closure date.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Framework published read-only with change history and the publication notice issued.
generic.Evidence location: Confluence enterprise framework page and the SharePoint publication notice.

steps.title: Capture delivery lead approval on the final draft
sop: Route the final draft to the delivery lead for approval.
Capture the approval against the specific draft version, not a date alone.
Record any conditions attached to the approval.
Done when the approval is recorded against the named version.
verify: Open the approval record and check it names the draft version.
Pass when no version is published without a recorded approval.

steps.title: Publish the framework to the enterprise Confluence space
sop: Move the approved draft into the enterprise Confluence space.
Set page permissions so consumers have read-only access.
Confirm restricted editing is limited to the framework owners.
Done when the framework is published with read-only consumer access.
verify: Open the page as a standard squad member account.
Pass when the page is readable and not editable by consumers.

steps.title: Increment the version number and complete the change history
sop: Increment the version number on the framework page header.
Complete the change history table with what changed and why.
Reference the improvement actions or CoE decisions behind each change.
Done when the change history covers every change in this version.
verify: Compare the change history entries to the tracked draft changes.
Pass when no accepted change is absent from the history table.

steps.title: Issue the publication notice to Scrum Masters, POs and the CoE
sop: Send the notice to all Scrum Masters, Product Owners and the IT Agile CoE.
State what changed, the effective date and where to raise questions.
Store a copy of the notice in SharePoint with the framework evidence.
Done when the notice is issued to all three audiences.
verify: Check the distribution list resolves to the current role holders.
Pass when no audience listed in the plan is missed.

steps.title: Update the PMO landing page link to the new version
sop: Repoint the PMO landing page link to the newly published version.
Check other spaces linking to the framework and update those links.
Confirm the link text names the version so readers can verify.
Done when the landing page points at the current version.
verify: Follow the PMO landing page link from a squad account.
Pass when the link resolves to the newly published version.

steps.title: Withdraw the superseded framework version
sop: Archive the superseded page and remove it from navigation.
Add a banner on the archived page pointing to the current version.
Confirm no live link reaches the superseded version.
Done when the superseded version is archived and signposted.
verify: Search Confluence and the PMO landing page for links to the old version.
Pass when the superseded version is no longer reachable from the landing page.

generic.Defined scope/population: Agile adoption coverage, delivery throughput and maturity scores for all squads in the quarter.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting quarter, using sprints closed within the quarter.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Report carries adoption coverage, throughput, predictability and maturity distribution sections.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reported figures tie back to the Jira Align extract row for row.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Report pack and source extract stored in SharePoint with the extract run date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Squads excluded from the figures are listed with the reason and the effect on coverage.
generic.Test population: All squads reported in the quarterly agile adoption pack.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every reported figure ties to the Jira Align extract for the quarter.
generic.Exception handling path: Excluded squads are named with the reason and the effect on coverage.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Report issued with adoption, throughput and maturity sections and commentary.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint quarterly report pack with the attached Jira Align extract.

steps.title: Extract adoption, throughput and predictability from Jira Align
sop: Extract squads on the framework, throughput and predictability for the quarter.
Use the published metric definitions so the figures are reproducible.
Save the extract with its run date alongside the report pack.
Done when the extract covers every squad for the full quarter.
verify: Reconcile the extract squad count against the train roster.
Pass when no in-scope squad is missing from the extract.

steps.title: Reconcile throughput against the published metric definitions
sop: Recompute throughput from the definition and compare to the extract figure.
Investigate any difference before the number enters the pack.
Record the reconciliation result with the extract.
Done when the throughput figure is reconciled and the check recorded.
verify: Compare the pack figure against the recomputed figure.
Pass when no reported figure differs from the source extract.

steps.title: Write the quarter-on-quarter movement commentary
sop: Compare each measure against the prior quarter and state the movement.
Name the squads driving the movement rather than describing it generically.
State the known causes such as attrition, freeze periods or scope shifts.
Done when every material movement has written commentary.
verify: Check each commentary point cites a squad or a specific event.
Pass when no movement is explained without naming its driver.

steps.title: Add the maturity score distribution across squads
sop: Pull the quarter maturity scores from the maturity tracker.
Show the distribution across squads and dimensions.
Highlight the dimensions where the train is weakest.
Done when the maturity distribution section is complete.
verify: Cross-check the distribution against the maturity tracker entries.
Pass when the distribution matches the recorded quarter scores.

steps.title: Assemble and store the quarterly report pack
sop: Assemble adoption, throughput and maturity sections into the pack.
Attach the source extract so figures can be traced.
Store the pack in SharePoint under the quarter reference.
Done when the pack is complete and stored with its source extract.
verify: Open the stored pack and check the extract is attached.
Pass when every reported figure is traceable to the attached extract.

steps.title: Present the pack at the PMO leadership review and log actions
sop: Present the pack at the quarterly PMO leadership review.
Record the questions raised and any challenge to the figures.
Log each action with an owner and a due date.
Done when the review is held and actions are logged.
verify: Check the minutes list an owner and date against each action.
Pass when no raised action is left without an owner.

generic.Defined scope/population: Rolling six-sprint velocity and completion rate for every squad in the train.
generic.In-scope period: The trailing six sprints for each squad at the point of review.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each squad trend records velocity, completion rate, capacity normalisation and variance.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Squad count in the trend view equals the squad count on the train roster.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Trend charts and flag decisions stored in Confluence with the extract date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Squads flagged then cleared are logged with the explaining event and decision.
generic.Test population: Every squad in the train with six closed sprints of velocity data.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: All trends normalised for size and capacity before variance is judged.
generic.Exception handling path: Squad flagged then cleared is logged with the explaining event and decision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Rolling velocity trend maintained per squad with variance against tolerance.
generic.Evidence location: Confluence velocity trend page and the coaching pipeline entries.

steps.title: Pull the rolling six-sprint velocity chart per squad from Jira
sop: Extract velocity and completion rate for the trailing six sprints per squad.
Use the published velocity definition so squads are comparable.
Save the extract with its run date.
Done when every squad has a six-sprint trend extract.
verify: Check the extract covers six closed sprints for each squad.
Pass when no squad trend is built on fewer than six closed sprints.

steps.title: Normalise for squad size and holiday capacity
sop: Adjust each squad trend for headcount changes over the six sprints.
Adjust for holiday and public holiday capacity loss per sprint.
Record the normalisation basis alongside the trend.
Done when every trend states its normalisation basis.
verify: Check two squads with different headcount changes for consistent treatment.
Pass when no trend is compared without a stated normalisation basis.

steps.title: Identify declining trends and variance above tolerance
sop: Compare each squad trend against the agreed variance tolerance.
List squads with a sustained decline or variance above tolerance.
Record the size of the movement, not just the direction.
Done when the candidate flag list is produced with figures.
verify: Recompute variance for one listed squad from the extract.
Pass when the variance shown matches the underlying data.

steps.title: Check candidate squads against known explaining events
sop: Check each candidate against release freezes, attrition and reassignments.
Speak to the squad Scrum Master before treating the decline as a problem.
Record the explanation or the absence of one.
Done when every candidate has an explanation check recorded.
verify: Read the check record for each candidate squad.
Pass when no squad is flagged without a documented explanation check.

steps.title: Add confirmed squads to the coaching pipeline
sop: Add each confirmed squad to the coaching pipeline in Confluence.
Record the trend evidence and the suspected constraint.
Set the coaching focus so the first session is not spent diagnosing.
Done when every confirmed squad is on the coaching pipeline.
verify: Open the coaching pipeline and check the evidence link per entry.
Pass when every pipeline entry carries its trend evidence.

steps.title: Notify the flagged squads and their Product Owners
sop: Tell each flagged squad Scrum Master what was seen and why.
Share the trend chart so the conversation starts from evidence.
Agree the first coaching session date.
Done when every flagged squad has been notified with the evidence.
verify: Check each flagged squad has a recorded notification and session date.
Pass when no squad learns of its flag from the report rather than directly.

generic.Defined scope/population: All stories proposed for commitment into the sprint for the squad.
generic.In-scope period: The sprint being committed, from planning through to sprint start in Jira.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every committed story carries acceptance criteria, an estimate and a sprint assignment.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Committed story points equal the total shown against the started sprint in Jira.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Sprint goal, committed scope and start timestamp recorded in Jira and Confluence.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Stories committed without meeting Definition of Ready are logged with the approver.
generic.Test population: All stories proposed for commitment into the sprint.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Committed points sit within capacity and every story carries acceptance criteria.
generic.Exception handling path: Story committed without meeting the Definition of Ready records the approver.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Sprint started in Jira with a recorded sprint goal and committed scope.
generic.Evidence location: Jira sprint record and the Confluence sprint page for the committed scope.

steps.title: Agree and record the sprint goal in one sentence
sop: Draft the sprint goal as a single outcome sentence with the squad.
Check the goal describes value delivered, not a list of stories.
Record the goal on the Jira sprint and the Confluence sprint page.
Done when the sprint goal is recorded and agreed by the squad.
verify: Read the goal back to the squad and ask if the sprint would fail without it.
Pass when the goal is one sentence and agreed by the squad.

steps.title: Check every candidate story against the Definition of Ready
sop: Apply the Definition of Ready checklist to each candidate story in Jira.
Confirm acceptance criteria are present and testable on each story.
Return failing stories to refinement rather than committing them.
Done when every candidate story passes the Definition of Ready.
verify: Filter the sprint for stories with empty acceptance criteria.
Pass when the filter returns no committed stories.

steps.title: Verify committed points against the agreed sprint capacity
sop: Compare the committed point total against the confirmed sprint capacity.
Remove or defer stories where the commitment exceeds capacity.
Record the final committed point total against the sprint.
Done when committed points sit within the agreed capacity.
verify: Compare the Jira committed total against the recorded capacity figure.
Pass when the commitment does not exceed agreed capacity.

steps.title: Mirror the commitment on the Azure DevOps board where used
sop: Confirm the same committed set is reflected on the Azure Boards iteration.
Resolve any item present in one tool and absent in the other.
Record which tool is authoritative for the squad.
Done when both tools show the same committed scope.
verify: Compare the committed item lists in Jira and Azure DevOps.
Pass when no committed item is missing from either tool.

steps.title: Start the sprint in Jira to set the burn-down baseline
sop: Start the sprint in Jira on the agreed sprint start day.
Confirm the burn-down baseline reflects the committed points.
Check the sprint dates match the published cadence.
Done when the sprint is started with a correct baseline.
verify: Open the burn-down chart and check the day-one baseline.
Pass when the baseline equals the committed point total.

steps.title: Publish the committed sprint scope to stakeholders
sop: Publish the sprint goal and committed scope on the Confluence sprint page.
Send the scope to the stakeholders who raised the work.
State that later additions will be visible as scope change.
Done when the committed scope is published to stakeholders.
verify: Compare the published scope against the started Jira sprint.
Pass when the published scope matches the committed sprint exactly.

generic.Defined scope/population: The squad retrospective for the closed sprint including prior sprint improvement actions.
generic.In-scope period: The closed sprint, held within two working days of sprint end.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each captured action records owner, target sprint and the finding it addresses.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of agreed actions equals the count of Jira improvement items raised.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Retrospective page in Confluence with the session date and attendee list.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Findings agreed as no-action are recorded with the reason for not acting.
generic.Test population: The closed sprint retrospective including prior sprint improvement actions.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every agreed action exists in Jira with a named owner and a target sprint.
generic.Exception handling path: Finding agreed as no-action is recorded with the reason for not acting.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Retrospective notes recorded with improvement actions raised in Jira.
generic.Evidence location: Confluence retrospective page linked from the Jira sprint.

steps.title: Schedule and run the retrospective within two working days of sprint end
sop: Book the retrospective within two working days of sprint end.
Confirm the whole squad plus Product Owner can attend.
Open the session with the agreed working format.
Done when the retrospective is held on time with the squad present.
verify: Compare the session date against the sprint end date.
Pass when the session ran within two working days of sprint end.

steps.title: Review the previous sprint improvement actions first
sop: Open the previous retrospective actions in Jira before new topics.
Confirm which closed, which are open and which stalled.
Establish the blocker for any action that did not move.
Done when every prior action has a stated current position.
verify: Filter last sprint improvement items for those without a status update.
Pass when no prior action is left unreviewed.

steps.title: Capture what went well, what did not and agreed experiments
sop: Record the observations under the three headings on the Confluence page.
Capture the words used rather than a sanitised summary.
Group repeated observations so themes are visible.
Done when the session content is captured on the retrospective page.
verify: Read the page back to the squad at session close.
Pass when the squad confirms the record reflects the discussion.

steps.title: Raise each agreed action as a Jira improvement item
sop: Create a Jira improvement item for each agreed action.
Assign a named owner and a target sprint to each item.
Link the item back to the retrospective page.
Done when every agreed action exists as a tracked Jira item.
verify: Filter the improvement backlog for items without owner or target sprint.
Pass when the filter returns no results for this retrospective.

steps.title: Check the written record for blame framing
sop: Re-read the retrospective record before publishing.
Rewrite any observation that names an individual in a fault framing.
Keep the substance of the issue while removing the personal attribution.
Done when the record is free of individual blame framing.
verify: Search the record for individual names attached to failures.
Pass when no individual is named in a blame framing.

steps.title: Publish the retrospective record and share the actions
sop: Publish the retrospective page and link it from the sprint page.
Share the actions with the squad and the Product Owner.
Store the record in SharePoint where the squad space requires it.
Done when the record is published and the actions shared.
verify: Open the sprint page and follow the retrospective link.
Pass when the published record lists every agreed action with an owner.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every member of the squad for the sprint dates being planned.
generic.In-scope period: The sprint window from sprint start day to sprint end day.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each member has available days recorded net of leave, training and support rota.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sum of member availability equals the squad capacity figure entered in Jira.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Jira sprint capacity view holds the figures with the planning date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Members whose availability is unknown at planning are logged with a confirmation date.
generic.Test population: Every squad member for the sprint dates being planned.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Capacity recorded per member net of leave, training and standing commitments.
generic.Exception handling path: Member with unknown availability is logged with a confirmation date.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Sprint capacity recorded in the Jira capacity view before commitment is taken.
generic.Evidence location: Jira sprint capacity view and the team calendar in Microsoft 365.

steps.title: Collect leave, training and holidays for the sprint dates
sop: Ask each squad member for booked leave and training in the sprint window.
Add the public holidays falling inside the sprint dates.
Record the source of each entry so it can be checked later.
Done when every member has stated their unavailable days.
verify: Compare the collected leave against the team calendar in Microsoft 365.
Pass when no booked leave in the sprint window is missing.

steps.title: Deduct standing commitments from raw availability
sop: Deduct the production support rota allocation per member.
Deduct the standing ceremony time for the sprint.
Deduct any committed cross-squad or governance time.
Done when standing commitments are deducted for every member.
verify: Check the support rota against the deductions applied.
Pass when every member on the rota carries the matching deduction.

steps.title: Enter per-member availability into the Jira capacity view
sop: Enter available days or hours for each member in the Jira sprint capacity view.
Confirm the total matches the sum of the member figures.
Record the entry date so late changes are visible.
Done when every member has a capacity figure in Jira.
verify: Open the Jira capacity view and look for members at default capacity.
Pass when no member is shown at full capacity while leave exists.

steps.title: Mirror the capacity on the Azure DevOps iteration where used
sop: Enter the same capacity figures on the Azure Boards iteration.
Resolve any difference between the two tools before planning.
Note which tool the squad treats as authoritative.
Done when both tools carry the same capacity figures.
verify: Compare the capacity totals in Jira and Azure DevOps.
Pass when the two totals agree.

steps.title: Compare capacity against rolling velocity and flag drops
sop: Compare the sprint capacity against the rolling velocity baseline.
Calculate the percentage drop where capacity is materially lower.
Flag any material drop to the Product Owner before commitment.
Done when the comparison is done and material drops are flagged.
verify: Check the flagged drops were raised before the commitment session.
Pass when no material capacity drop reaches commitment unflagged.

steps.title: Have the squad confirm the capacity figure
sop: Present the capacity figure to the squad in planning.
Take corrections where availability was mis-stated.
Record the confirmed figure against the sprint.
Done when the squad has confirmed the capacity figure.
verify: Check the sprint record for the confirmed capacity and date.
Pass when capacity is recorded and confirmed before commitment is taken.

generic.Defined scope/population: All candidate backlog stories being refined for upcoming sprints.
generic.In-scope period: The refinement cycle covering the next two sprints of backlog content.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each story carries user need format, Given/When/Then criteria, business value and priority.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of stories passing the standard equals the refined-ready count on the board.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Story history in Jira records the review and the requirements repository link.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Stories returned to the author are logged with the specific gap and return date.
generic.Test population: All candidate backlog stories refined for the next two sprints.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every refined story carries testable criteria and populated value and priority.
generic.Exception handling path: Story failing the standard is returned to the author with the gap named.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Backlog stories carry testable acceptance criteria and business value fields.
generic.Evidence location: Jira story records and the linked requirements repository entries.

steps.title: Check each story states the user, the need and the benefit
sop: Read each candidate story against the agreed user story format.
Confirm the user, the need and the benefit are all present.
Rewrite with the author where the benefit is missing or generic.
Done when every candidate story states user, need and benefit.
verify: Sample five refined stories in Jira for the three elements.
Pass when no refined story is missing any of the three.

steps.title: Confirm acceptance criteria are testable Given/When/Then conditions
sop: Read the acceptance criteria on each story for testability.
Confirm each criterion is in Given/When/Then form with an expected result.
Reject criteria that restate the story instead of defining a test.
Done when every story carries testable acceptance criteria.
verify: Attempt to write a test case from the criteria of three stories.
Pass when each criterion yields an unambiguous test.

steps.title: Verify business value and priority fields are populated
sop: Check the business value and priority fields on each candidate story in Jira.
Populate missing values with the Product Owner rather than guessing.
Confirm values are set on the agreed scale so ordering is possible.
Done when every story carries business value and priority.
verify: Filter the refined backlog for stories with empty value or priority.
Pass when the filter returns no results.

steps.title: Call out policy, rating or regulatory impact on the story
sop: Identify stories touching policy wording, rating rules or regulatory obligations.
Add the impact statement and link the source requirement in the repository.
Flag the story so testing coverage picks it up.
Done when every impacted story carries the statement and source link.
verify: Open the requirements repository link on two flagged stories.
Pass when each link resolves to the governing source requirement.

steps.title: Return non-conforming stories to the author with the gap named
sop: List the specific standard each failing story misses.
Return the story to the author in Jira with the gap in the comment.
Set a return date so refinement is not blocked.
Done when every failing story is returned with a named gap.
verify: Read the return comments for specificity.
Pass when no story is returned without the specific gap named.

steps.title: Record the conformance position on the refinement page
sop: Record how many candidate stories passed and how many were returned.
Publish the position on the Confluence refinement page.
Carry returned stories forward to the next refinement session.
Done when the conformance position is recorded for the cycle.
verify: Compare the recorded pass count against the ready column in Jira.
Pass when no story enters sprint planning without acceptance criteria.

steps.title: Select the epics due in the next two increments

steps.title: Flag stories touching the policy administration system for a spike

steps.title: Check the resulting stories against the sprint-fit threshold

steps.title: Record the grooming outcome on the Confluence page

Note the slicing rationale for the epics that were hardest to split.
Publish the page and link it from the backlog view.
Done when the grooming outcome is recorded and published.

Pass when each in-scope epic is decomposed or explicitly deferred with a reason.

generic.Defined scope/population: Stories completed in the sprint that are eligible for demonstration to stakeholders.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items pulled from the demo are logged with the reason and the next review date.

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Sprint review held with stakeholder feedback logged as backlog items.
generic.Evidence location: Jira feedback items and the Confluence sprint review record.

steps.title: Confirm each demo candidate meets the Definition of Done
sop: Apply the Definition of Done to each item proposed for demonstration.
Remove any item that does not meet every condition.
Record which items were removed and why.
Done when the demo list contains only items meeting the DoD.
verify: Check the demo list against the Done column in Jira.
Pass when no incomplete story is on the demo list.

steps.title: Invite the impacted Operations, Underwriting and Distribution representatives
sop: Identify the operational areas the sprint content affects.
Send invitations to the named representatives from each area.
Chase acceptance from any area with no confirmed attendee.
Done when each impacted area has a confirmed attendee.
verify: Check the acceptance list against the impacted area list.
Pass when no impacted area is unrepresented at the review.

steps.title: Demonstrate working software against the acceptance criteria
sop: Walk each item against its acceptance criteria in the working system.
Avoid slides that describe what was built instead of showing it.
Show the negative path where it is relevant to the business.
Done when every listed item has been demonstrated live.
verify: Compare the items demonstrated against the demo list.
Pass when every listed item was shown running, not described.

steps.title: Log stakeholder feedback as backlog items or story comments
sop: Capture each piece of feedback as it is raised in the session.
Raise a Jira backlog item for new requests and comment on existing stories.
Tag the feedback with the sprint and the raising stakeholder.
Done when every piece of feedback is logged in Jira.
verify: Compare the session notes against the raised Jira items.
Pass when no captured feedback is missing from Jira.

steps.title: Confirm with the Product Owner which feedback changes priority
sop: Review the logged feedback with the Product Owner after the session.
Decide which items change backlog priority and which do not.
Record the priority decision on each feedback item.
Done when every feedback item has a priority decision.
verify: Filter the feedback items for those without a priority decision.
Pass when the filter returns no results.

steps.title: Publish the review record and share with stakeholders
sop: Write up the review outcome on the Confluence sprint page.
List the items demonstrated, the feedback raised and the decisions taken.
Share the record with the attending stakeholders in SharePoint.
Done when the review record is published and shared.
verify: Open the published record and check every feedback item is listed.
Pass when the record matches the Jira feedback items raised.

generic.Defined scope/population: All refined backlog items presented to the squad for story-point estimation.

generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of items estimated equals the count of items presented for estimation.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Point values recorded in Jira during the session with the estimation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items left unestimated pending a spike are logged with the spike reference.
