generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every refined item carries a point value and none exceeds the squad ceiling.
generic.Exception handling path: Item left unestimated pending a spike carries the spike reference.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Story point values recorded on all refined backlog items in Jira.
generic.Evidence location: Jira story records and the Confluence reference story page.

steps.title: Confirm the reference story for the point scale is still valid
sop: Open the squad reference story and check it still reflects a typical item.
Replace the reference story if the squad or technology has moved on.
Record the current reference story in Confluence.
Done when the squad agrees the reference story is representative.
verify: Ask two squad members to size the reference story blind.
Pass when both return the reference value.

steps.title: Run planning poker so estimates are independent
sop: Present each item and allow questions before any number is given.
Take estimates simultaneously so nobody anchors on another.
Reveal all estimates together for each item.
Done when every item has independent estimates from the squad.
verify: Observe whether any estimate was stated before reveal.
Pass when no item is estimated after a number was voiced aloud.

steps.title: Resolve wide spreads by surfacing the hidden assumption
sop: Ask the highest and lowest estimators to explain their reasoning.
Identify the assumption or unknown driving the spread.
Re-estimate after the assumption is resolved rather than averaging.
Done when every wide spread has been discussed and re-estimated.
verify: Check whether any final value is the arithmetic mean of a spread.
Pass when no estimate was settled by averaging.

steps.title: Record the agreed point value on each story in Jira
sop: Enter the agreed point value on each story during the session.
Add a note where an assumption underpins the estimate.
Mirror the value on Azure Boards where the squad uses it.
Done when every estimated item carries its value in the tool.
verify: Filter the refined backlog for items without a point value.
Pass when the filter returns no results.

steps.title: Split stories estimated above the squad ceiling
sop: Identify stories estimated above the agreed squad point ceiling.
Split each into parts that each deliver value.
Re-estimate the parts in the same session where possible.
Done when no refined story exceeds the ceiling.
verify: Filter the refined backlog for estimates above the ceiling.
Pass when no refined story exceeds the ceiling without being split.

steps.title: Record unresolved items and raise spikes
sop: List items the squad could not estimate due to unknowns.
Raise a spike in Jira for each with a defined question to answer.
Return the item to the next refinement session.
Done when every unestimated item has a linked spike.
verify: Check unestimated items for a linked spike reference.
Pass when no item is left unestimated without a spike.

generic.Defined scope/population: All squad impediments whose resolution depends on another team or squad.
generic.In-scope period: The current sprint, from the point the blocker is identified to acknowledgement.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each blocker records blocking reason, owning team, contact, impact and raise date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of Blocked stories in Jira equals the blocker count on the programme board.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Blockers resolved before escalation are closed with the resolution recorded.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every Blocked story names a blocking team, contact, impact and raise date.
generic.Exception handling path: Blocker resolved before escalation is closed with the resolution recorded.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Cross-team blockers visible on the programme board with impact and owning team.
generic.Evidence location: Jira Blocked stories and the Jira Align programme board entries.

steps.title: Mark the affected stories Blocked in Jira with the reason
sop: Move each affected story to Blocked status in Jira.
Record the blocking reason in the story field, not a comment thread.
Set the blocked date so ageing can be measured.
Done when every affected story is Blocked with a reason recorded.
verify: Filter Blocked stories for an empty blocking reason.
Pass when no story sits in Blocked without a stated reason.

steps.title: Name the owning team and the person contacted
sop: Identify which squad or team the dependency actually sits with.
Record the name of the person contacted and the date of contact.
Confirm the contact is the right route rather than a general inbox.
Done when the owning team and contact are recorded on the blocker.
verify: Check each Blocked story for a named owning team and contact.
Pass when no blocker lacks a named blocking team.

steps.title: Quantify the delivery impact of the blocker
sop: State how many stories and points are at risk from the blocker.
State whether the sprint goal or a release date is threatened.
Express the impact in delivery terms rather than as an inconvenience.
Done when the impact is quantified against the sprint or release.
verify: Read the impact statement for figures rather than adjectives.
Pass when every blocker carries a quantified impact.

steps.title: Raise the blocker on the Jira Align programme board
sop: Create the blocker entry on the Jira Align programme board.
Link it to the Blocked Jira stories so the trail holds.
Set the visibility so the train sees it at the next sync.
Done when the blocker is visible at train level.
verify: Open the programme board and locate the blocker.
Pass when every Blocked story maps to a programme board entry.

steps.title: Confirm Release Train Engineer acknowledgement and resolution owner
sop: Confirm the RTE has seen the blocker and accepted it onto the train view.
Agree the named resolution owner and a target resolution date.
Record the acknowledgement against the blocker.
Done when the blocker carries an acknowledgement and resolution owner.
verify: Check the blocker record for an acknowledgement date and owner.
Pass when no raised blocker is left unacknowledged.

steps.title: Circulate the blocker position to squad and stakeholders
sop: Summarise the open blockers and their impacts for the squad.
Share the position with the affected stakeholders through Microsoft 365.
Repeat at each stand-up until the blocker clears.
Done when the blocker position is communicated and repeated daily.
verify: Compare the circulated list against the programme board entries.
Pass when the circulated position matches the board.

generic.Defined scope/population: At least one improvement action drawn from the retrospective backlog into the sprint.

generic.Evidence location: Jira improvement item and the Confluence squad working agreement.

steps.title: Pull an improvement action from the retrospective backlog into the sprint
sop: Review the retrospective improvement backlog before sprint planning.
Select at least one action that is achievable inside the sprint.
Add it to the sprint backlog in Jira alongside delivery work.
Done when at least one improvement item is in the sprint.
verify: Open the sprint in Jira and filter for improvement items.
Pass when at least one improvement action is in the sprint backlog.

steps.title: Assign an owner and make its status visible
sop: Assign a named owner to the improvement item, not the whole squad.
Place it on the board so its status is visible at stand-up.
State the intended effect so completion can be judged.
Done when the item has an owner and appears on the board.
verify: Check the item is assigned and visible in the sprint board columns.
Pass when the improvement is tracked like any other sprint item.

steps.title: Apply the change during the sprint
sop: Make the agreed change to the ceremony, board or working practice.
Apply it from an agreed date so before and after can be compared.
Tell the squad the change is now live.
Done when the change is applied and the squad is aware.
verify: Observe the ceremony or board after the change date.
Pass when the change is visibly in effect.

steps.title: Update the working agreement or board configuration to make it stick
sop: Update the squad working agreement in Confluence with the change.
Adjust the Jira or Azure DevOps board configuration where required.
Version the working agreement and note what changed.
Done when the change is embedded in the agreement or tooling.
verify: Open the working agreement and the board configuration.
Pass when the change is present in the documented or configured state.

steps.title: Close the improvement item in Jira
sop: Confirm the stated closure evidence exists before closing.
Close the improvement item in Jira within the sprint.
Link the evidence to the closed item.
Done when the improvement item is closed with evidence.
verify: Check the closed item carries a link to the applied change.
Pass when no improvement item is closed without evidence.

steps.title: Review the effect at the next retrospective and keep or revert
sop: Ask at the next retrospective whether the change had the intended effect.
Decide explicitly to keep, adjust or revert the change.
Record the decision against the improvement item.
Done when the keep or revert decision is recorded.
verify: Check the improvement backlog for items ageing past the sprint limit.
Pass when no improvement item ages beyond the agreed limit untouched.

generic.Defined scope/population: All backlog items whose delivery depends on work owned by another squad.

steps.title: Create a Jira issue link for each cross-squad dependency
sop: Identify every backlog item that depends on another squad.
Create the blocking and blocked issue links in Jira.
Avoid recording dependencies only in comments or spreadsheets.
Done when every dependency exists as a Jira issue link.
verify: Filter squad items with an external dependency for a missing link.

steps.title: Confirm the providing squad has committed the dependent item

verify: Open the providing squad sprint and locate the dependent item.

steps.title: Agree the handover date and acceptance condition
sop: Agree with the providing squad the date the dependency lands.
Define what the receiving squad must be able to do to accept it.
Record both on the dependency link in Jira.
Done when handover date and acceptance condition are recorded.
verify: Check each dependency for a handover date and acceptance condition.

steps.title: Show the dependency on the Jira Align programme board
sop: Add each dependency to the programme board with its sequencing.
Confirm the board shows which squad provides and which receives.
Check the sequencing reflects the agreed handover dates.
Done when every dependency is visible at train level.
verify: Compare the programme board entries against the Jira links.
Pass when the counts and directions match.

sop: Review every open dependency at each sprint planning session.
Update the status and the handover date where it has moved.
Record the review date against each dependency.
Done when every open dependency is reviewed each planning.
verify: Check dependencies for a review date within the current sprint.
Pass when no open dependency is left unreviewed at planning.

sop: Raise any slipped handover date to the RTE as soon as it is known.
State the delivery impact on the receiving squad commitment.
Record the escalation and the agreed recovery on the dependency.
Done when every slipped dependency carries an escalation record.
verify: Filter for dependencies past their handover date.
Pass when each has a recorded escalation and recovery position.

steps.title: Score each candidate item using WSJF or the agreed MoSCoW method
sop: Score business value, time criticality, risk reduction and job size per item.
Apply the same scale across all items so scores are comparable.
Record the four inputs and the resulting WSJF score in Jira.
Done when every candidate item carries a recorded score.
verify: Recompute WSJF for three items from the recorded inputs.

steps.title: Source value and time-criticality inputs from the roadmap and deadlines
sop: Take business value from the product roadmap benefit statements.
Take time criticality from regulatory deadlines and market commitments.
Record the source reference against each input rather than an opinion.

verify: Open the roadmap reference behind two scored items.

steps.title: Reorder the Jira backlog so rank matches the score
sop: Sort the candidate list by score and apply the order as Jira rank.
Resolve ties using the documented tie-break rule.
Confirm the board backlog view reflects the new rank.
Done when Jira rank order matches the score order.
verify: Export the ranked backlog and compare to the score order.
Pass when rank and score order agree item for item.

steps.title: Sequence regulatory and filing deadline items ahead of discretionary work
sop: Identify items carrying a fixed regulatory or filing deadline.
Confirm each is sequenced early enough to meet its deadline.
Raise any deadline item that cannot be met at the current rank.
Done when every deadline item is sequenced against its date.
verify: Compare each deadline item rank against its required completion date.
Pass when no deadline item is sequenced behind discretionary work.

sop: List every item ranked against its calculated score.
Record the rationale and the approver for each override.
Keep the override visible so it is not mistaken for a scoring error.
Done when every override carries a rationale and approver.
verify: Compare the rank order against the score order and list the differences.
Pass when every difference has a recorded rationale.

steps.title: Publish the top-of-backlog order to stakeholders

Include the scores so the ordering can be challenged on evidence.
Store the published order in the PPM tool against the roadmap.
Done when the ordered backlog is published with its scores.
verify: Compare the published order against the Jira rank on the same day.
Pass when the two match.

steps.title: Close the sprint in Jira so figures are final

Confirm the velocity figure has settled after closure.
Done when the sprint is closed and the velocity is final.
verify: Check the sprint status in Jira before extracting.

sop: Extract velocity and burn-down for the closed sprint.

sop: Check the dashboard refresh timestamp has updated.
Confirm the closed sprint appears in the trend series for each squad.

sop: Compare the loaded figures against the Jira Align train-level view.

Record the reconciliation result with the extract.

verify: Read the reconciliation record for unresolved differences.

sop: Post the publication notice to the PMO channel in Microsoft 365.

Invite challenge on any figure that looks wrong.
Done when the notice is posted for the closed sprint.
verify: Check the notice names the sprint reference and the dashboard link.
Pass when the notice matches the published sprint.

steps.title: Share the daily position with the Product Owner and stakeholders

steps.title: Retire any parallel spreadsheet tracking

Pass when no sprint status is tracked outside the backlog tool.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every sprint goal and its committed content for the squads in the increment.

sop: Circulate the scope and criteria before execution planning.
Take agreement from the business Product Owner and the IT test lead.
Version the document and store it against the release in Confluence.

sop: Route the plan to the release governance for approval.

verify: Read the change history entries for improvement action references.
Pass when every change traces to a closed improvement action.

steps.title: Notify Scrum Masters and Product Owners of the effective date
sop: Notify Scrum Masters and Product Owners of the change.
State the date the change takes effect.
Publish the notice in Microsoft 365 and Confluence.
Done when the community is notified with an effective date.
verify: Check the notice distribution and the stated effective date.
Pass when both audiences were notified with a date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Improvement actions raised, completed and open across squads in the quarter.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting quarter for improvement activity and flow metric trends.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Report records completed actions, measured outcomes, open position and flow trends.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reported action counts equal the Jira Align improvement backlog for the quarter.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Report and its source extract stored in SharePoint with the extract date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Actions whose outcome could not be measured are stated as unmeasurable with the reason.
generic.Test population: Improvement actions raised, completed and open across squads in the quarter.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Reported action counts equal the Jira Align improvement backlog for the quarter.
generic.Exception handling path: Action whose outcome could not be measured is stated as unmeasurable.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Quarterly report published showing actions completed and measured outcomes.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint quarterly report with the attached Jira Align extract.

steps.title: Report actions completed against those raised
sop: Extract improvement actions raised and completed in the quarter.
Show completion rate against the actions raised.
Save the extract with its run date.
Done when the raised and completed position is reported.
verify: Compare the report against the Jira Align improvement backlog.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Show the measured outcome for each completed action
sop: Record the measured outcome for each completed action.
State explicitly where an outcome could not be measured.
Avoid claiming success without a measure.
Done when every completed action carries an outcome position.
verify: Read the outcomes for unsupported success claims.
Pass when no completed action is reported successful without a measured or unmeasurable statement.

steps.title: Report the open action position including overdue items
sop: Report the open actions and how many are overdue.
State the reason for each overdue action.
Show the ageing of the open backlog.
Done when the open and overdue position is reported.
verify: Compare the overdue count against the improvement backlog ageing.
Pass when the figures agree.

steps.title: Show flow metric trends alongside the improvement narrative
sop: Show cycle time, velocity and predictability trends for the quarter.
Place them alongside the improvement claims so they can be tested.
Use the published metric definitions.
Done when the flow trends are shown with the narrative.
verify: Compare the trends against the Jira Align metric extract.
Pass when the trends match the extract.

steps.title: Assemble and store the quarterly report
sop: Assemble the completed, open and trend sections into the report.
Attach the source extract for traceability.
Store the report in SharePoint under the quarter reference.
Done when the report is assembled and stored with its extract.
verify: Open the stored report and check the attached extract.
Pass when every reported figure is traceable to the extract.

steps.title: Issue to PMO leadership and publish to the delivery community
sop: Issue the report to PMO leadership.
Publish it to the delivery community in Confluence.
Invite challenge on any claimed outcome.
Done when the report is issued and published.
verify: Check the report is reachable by the delivery community.
Pass when both leadership and the community have the report.

generic.Defined scope/population: Squad nominations assessed against the published delivery excellence recognition criteria.
generic.In-scope period: The recognition cycle from nomination opening to award issue.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each nomination records evidence against every criterion and the scoring rationale.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Nominations scored equal the nominations received in the cycle.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Criteria, nominations and rationale stored in Confluence with the cycle date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Nominations excluded are logged with the reason and feedback to the nominator.
generic.Test population: Squad nominations assessed against the published recognition criteria.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every nomination is scored against all criteria with a recorded rationale.
generic.Exception handling path: Nomination excluded is logged with the reason and feedback to the nominator.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Recognition awards issued with recorded rationale against the published criteria.
generic.Evidence location: Confluence recognition record holding criteria, nominations and rationale.

steps.title: Publish the recognition criteria
sop: Publish criteria covering delivery outcome, quality and improvement behaviour.
State the evidence expected against each criterion.
Publish before nominations open so it is not retrofitted.
Done when the criteria are published ahead of nominations.
verify: Compare the publication date against the nomination opening.
Pass when the criteria were published first.

steps.title: Collect nominations with supporting evidence
sop: Collect nominations through the published route.
Require evidence against each criterion in the nomination.
Return nominations submitted without evidence.
Done when every accepted nomination carries evidence.
verify: Filter the nominations for missing evidence.
Pass when every accepted nomination has evidence per criterion.

steps.title: Score nominations consistently and record the rationale
sop: Score every nomination against the same criteria.
Record the rationale for each score.
Use more than one scorer to reduce individual bias.
Done when every nomination is scored with a recorded rationale.
verify: Read the rationales against the criteria.
Pass when every score is explained against the published criteria.

steps.title: Confirm selection is not driven by velocity alone
sop: Check the selected squads against the non-velocity criteria.
Reject selections resting only on point throughput.
Record the check so point inflation is not rewarded.
Done when the velocity-only check is recorded.
verify: Read the selection rationale for the non-velocity criteria.
Pass when no award is made on velocity as the sole criterion.

steps.title: Issue the recognition to the selected squads
sop: Issue the recognition through the delivery excellence programme.
Record the award and its rationale in Jira Align.
Tell unsuccessful nominees what would have made the difference.
Done when awards are issued and recorded.
verify: Check the award record against the scoring rationale.
Pass when every award carries a recorded rationale.

steps.title: Share what the squad did so others can copy it
sop: Write up what the recognised squad did differently.
Publish the write-up in Confluence and SharePoint.
Point squads with similar constraints to the write-up.
Done when the practice write-up is published.
verify: Open the published write-up for the practice detail.
Pass when the write-up explains what other squads can copy.

generic.Defined scope/population: Improvement actions that have passed their target date without progressing.
generic.In-scope period: The current review cycle covering all open improvement actions.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each impediment records the cause classification, the owner and the next step.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Impediment records equal the overdue improvement actions on the backlog.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Impediment records held in Jira with the review date and the owner response.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Actions closed as no longer relevant are logged with the reason and approver.
generic.Test population: Improvement actions past their target date without progressing.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every overdue action carries a stated cause and a classification.
generic.Exception handling path: Action closed as no longer relevant is logged with the reason and approver.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Impediment recorded against every overdue improvement action with a stated cause.
generic.Evidence location: Jira impediment records with the review date and owner response.

steps.title: Identify improvement actions past their target date
sop: Filter the improvement backlog for actions past their target date.
Exclude those already re-dated with agreement.
Record the overdue list with the days overdue.
Done when the overdue list is produced.
verify: Compare the overdue list against the Jira backlog.
Pass when the two agree.

steps.title: Establish with the owner what is blocking each action
sop: Speak to each owner about what is actually blocking the action.
Record the cause in the owner's words.
Avoid recording lateness as the cause.
Done when every overdue action has a stated blocker.
verify: Read the impediment records for a stated cause.
Pass when every overdue action carries a stated cause.

steps.title: Classify each impediment
sop: Classify each impediment as capacity, dependency, decision needed or not relevant.
Record the classification against the action.
Use the classification to route the next step.
Done when every impediment is classified.
verify: Filter the impediment records for missing classifications.
Pass when the filter returns no results.

steps.title: Surface the impediment to the action owner and escalate where needed
sop: Tell the owner what is recorded as blocking their action.
Escalate impediments the owner cannot resolve through the escalation route.
Record the escalation with the recipient and date.
Done when every unresolvable impediment is escalated.
verify: Compare escalations against the unresolvable impediments.
Pass when each has a recorded escalation.

steps.title: Close or re-date actions that are no longer relevant
sop: Identify actions overtaken by events or no longer wanted.
Close them with a recorded reason rather than leaving them open.
Re-date actions that remain wanted with an agreed new date.
Done when every stale action is closed or re-dated.
verify: Filter the backlog for overdue actions with no impediment or re-plan.
Pass when no overdue improvement action is left without either.

steps.title: Report the impediment position to the improvement forum
sop: Summarise impediments by classification for the period.
Report to the improvement forum through Microsoft 365 and Jira Align.
Highlight the recurring classification so the pattern is visible.
Done when the impediment position is reported.
verify: Compare the summary against the impediment records.
Pass when the summary matches the recorded classifications.

generic.Defined scope/population: Improvement practices with evidenced benefit selected for cross-squad dissemination.
generic.In-scope period: The community of practice cycle in which the practices are shared.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each write-up records the problem, the method, the observed effect and the originating squad.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Practices published equal the practices presented at the community sessions.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Write-ups held in the Confluence practice library with author and publication date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Practices shared without measured benefit are logged with the caveat stated.
generic.Test population: Improvement practices with evidenced benefit selected for sharing.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every published practice states the problem, method and observed effect.
generic.Exception handling path: Practice shared without measured benefit is logged with the caveat stated.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Practice write-ups published with problem, method and observed effect.
generic.Evidence location: Confluence shared practice library with author and publication dates.

steps.title: Select practices with evidenced benefit in the originating squad
sop: Review improvement actions with a measured benefit.
Select the practices whose benefit is likely to transfer.
Discard practices whose benefit was situational or unmeasured.
Done when the selected practice list is produced with evidence.
verify: Read the evidence behind each selected practice.
Pass when no practice is selected without evidence of benefit.

steps.title: Write up each practice with problem, method and effect
sop: Write the problem the practice solves in operational terms.
Describe how to apply it step by step.
State the observed effect with the figures behind it.
Done when every practice has a complete write-up.
verify: Read a write-up as a squad that has not seen the practice.
Pass when the squad could apply it from the write-up alone.

steps.title: Present the practice at the community of practice session
sop: Present the practice with the originating squad present.
Let the squad describe what actually changed for them.
Record questions and adaptation ideas raised.
Done when the practice has been presented at the community.
verify: Check the session record for the presented practices.
Pass when every selected practice was presented.

steps.title: Publish the write-up to the shared practice library
sop: Publish each write-up to the Confluence practice library.
Tag it so squads with similar problems can find it.
Record the author and publication date.
Done when every write-up is published and tagged.
verify: Search the library for a practice by its problem tag.
Pass when the search returns the write-up.

steps.title: Track which squads adopted the practice
sop: Ask squads which practices they adopted after the session.
Record the adoptions against each practice.
Note the squads that considered and rejected it and why.
Done when adoption is recorded per practice.
verify: Read the adoption record against the published practices.
Pass when every published practice has an adoption position.

steps.title: Follow up on the effect adopting squads saw
sop: Ask adopting squads what effect they observed.
Record the effect against the practice write-up.
Amend the write-up where adoption revealed a gap.
Done when the observed effect is recorded for each adoption.
verify: Open a write-up and check the adoption effects recorded.
Pass when the library shows the effect seen by adopters.

generic.Defined scope/population: All open and recently closed retrospective improvement actions on the backlog.
generic.In-scope period: The tracking cycle refreshed before each retrospective.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each action records status, owner, target date and its closure evidence link.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Tracked action count equals the improvement items on the Jira backlog.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Tracker status recorded in Jira with update dates and the closure evidence links.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Actions closed without completion are logged with the reason and the approver.
generic.Test population: All open and recently closed retrospective improvement actions.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every closed action carries its stated closure evidence and completion rate is recorded.
generic.Exception handling path: Action closed without completion is logged with the reason and approver.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Improvement tracker shows current status and completion rate with ageing.
generic.Evidence location: Jira improvement backlog with the closure evidence links per action.

steps.title: Review the improvement backlog and update every open action
sop: Open the improvement backlog and review each open action.
Ask each owner for a current status.
Update the status in Jira.
Done when every open action has a current status.
verify: Filter the backlog for actions with a stale status.
Pass when no open action shows a stale status at review.

steps.title: Verify closure evidence before moving an action to Done
sop: Check the stated closure evidence exists for each action being closed.
Link the evidence to the action.
Reject closure claims with no evidence.
Done when every closed action carries its evidence.
verify: Open two closed actions and follow their evidence links.
Pass when no improvement action is closed without its stated closure evidence.

steps.title: Age the open actions and highlight overdue items
sop: Compute days open against target date for each action.
Highlight actions past their target date.
Record the ageing view with the review date.
Done when the ageing view is produced.
verify: Compare the ageing figures against the action target dates.
Pass when the ageing view matches the backlog dates.

steps.title: Record the completion rate for the cycle
sop: Compute the completion rate for the tracking cycle.
Compare against the previous cycle.
Record the rate in the tracker.
Done when the completion rate is recorded.
verify: Recompute the rate from the backlog statuses.
Pass when the recorded rate matches the recomputed figure.

steps.title: Report the completion rate at the next retrospective
sop: Present the completion rate and ageing at the next retrospective.
Show the squad whether its actions actually get done.
Record the discussion outcome.
Done when the completion position is reported to the squad.
verify: Check the retrospective record for the completion report.
Pass when the completion rate was presented.

steps.title: Re-plan or close actions open beyond the agreed limit
sop: Identify actions open beyond the agreed age limit.
Re-plan with a new owner or date, or close with a reason.
Mirror the position in Jira Align for train visibility.
Done when every aged action is re-planned or closed.
verify: Filter the backlog for actions past the age limit.
Pass when none is left without a re-plan or a closure reason.
